ap_interface.description: Wireless interface to use for the access point (must support AP mode)

driver.description: Wireless driver to use (nl80211 for modern Linux, bsd for BSD)

ssid.description: SSID (network name) broadcast by the access point

hw_mode.description: Hardware mode: 'g' (2.4 GHz IEEE 802.11g), 'a' (5 GHz), 'ac' (5 GHz 802.11ac), 'ax' (6 GHz or 5 GHz 802.11ax)

channel.description: Wi-Fi channel number (1–11 for 2.4 GHz, 36–165 for 5 GHz; depends on regulatory domain and DFS support)

ieee80211ax.description: Enable Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) — requires hardware and driver support

country_code.description: ISO/IEC 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for regulatory compliance (required for 5 GHz and DFS)

enable_dfs.description: Enable Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) to use 5 GHz channels requiring radar detection

beacon_int.description: Beacon interval in Time Units (TU); 1 TU = 1024 µs. Typical: 100 TU (≈102 ms)

dtim_period.description: Delivery Traffic Indication Message period — number of beacons between DTIMs

macaddr_acl.description: MAC ACL mode: 0=use deny list, 1=use accept list, 2=accept list only for WPA2-Enterprise

mac_accept_list_file.description: Path to file containing accepted MAC addresses (one per line)

mac_deny_list_file.description: Path to file containing denied MAC addresses (one per line)

mac_accept_list.description: List of accepted MAC addresses (if using inline ACL)

mac_deny_list.description: List of denied MAC addresses (if using inline ACL)

wpa_key_mgmt.description: WPA key management protocols (e.g., WPA-PSK, WPA-EAP, SAE for WPA3-Personal, FT-EAP for fast BSS transition)

wpa_passphrase.description: Pre-shared key for WPA-PSK; 8–63 ASCII characters (or 64 hex digits). Not used if RADIUS/EAP is configured.

radius_server.description: Primary RADIUS server IP address (for WPA-EAP)

radius_secret.description: Shared secret between hostapd and RADIUS server

radius_backup_server.description: Optional secondary RADIUS server IP (for failover)

tls_private_key_password.description: Password for the TLS server private key (if encrypted)

disable_wep.description: Disable WEP support (strongly recommended for security)

wps_enabled.description: Enable Wi-Fi Simple Setup (WPS); disable in enterprise deployments due to known vulnerabilities

bridge_interface.description: Bridge interface to connect AP clients to the wired network

ap_isolate.description: Isolate AP clients from each other (1=enabled, 0=disabled); useful for guest networks

openssl_ciphers.description: OpenSSL cipher list for TLS connections (EAP-TLS, etc.)
